items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023
items.q: It’s like Bill Evans, he hated it when people started to intellectualize about his music and stuff.

ctx.x: And that’s the secret, and that’s where the love is. I really, and it’s not a technical thing. It’s like Bill Evans, he hated it when people started to intellectualize about his music and stuff. It’s not anything intellectual, it’s about feeling. And it’s true that for us, us, that the performers that are into this feeling is the feeling comes from, it’s the rhythm that comes first. Become part of that rhythm. They’re not placed on top of the rhythm, they are the rhythm. It is the experience.

Wow. This has been a very fascinating conversation Mr. Broadbent, and I appreciate your time. Do you have a project to work on when we sign off? What are you working on right now? © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
